checks.description: Every sealed entry validates against needle-drop-schema.json (cwi-needledrop/v1): required keys present, placement_id matches ND-YYYY-NNN, status in {pending, claimed, verified}, terms has fee_tier/territory/term_length (undisclosed where private, never invented numbers), verified entries carry proof_url. Drafts validate against $defs.draft and can never be added as verified. Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

Only verified CWI facts ship: the ledger ships with placements: [] and states plainly that as of 2026-09-15 CWI has no verified sync placements; Zooted Zone ~307,000 lifetime plays (observed 2026-09-14), Kokurcho (producer), Hybrid (mix/master), Diabolique 2026-07-03 at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA, Frederick MD, hp@cumulativeweb.com. No fabricated productions, no invented terms/fees, no playlist adds presented as sync, no deny-list language.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.
EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (ledger, schema, card, page, syncdeck hub, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid ledger add/verify snippet.
